job.job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer Agentic AI & RAG
Location: PAN India
Experience: 512 Years




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI-native applications.
Build intelligent AI Agents using Agentic AI frameworks.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrating enterprise knowledge sources.
Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for enterprise use cases.
Integrate AI agents with APIs, databases, vector databases, and external tools.
Design scalable and secure AI architectures for production deployment.
Collaborate with data scientists, cloud engineers, and business stakeholders.
Monitor AI model performance, latency, hallucinations, and response quality.
Implement responsible AI practices including governance, guardrails, and security.



Must Have Skills

Strong experience in building AI-native applications.
Hands-on experience designing and deploying Agentic AI solutions.
Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Experience with Large Language Models (OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral).
Strong Python programming skills.
Experience with orchestration frameworks such as:
LangChain
LangGraph
LlamaIndex
CrewAI
AutoGen
Experience with vector databases:
Pinecone
FAISS
ChromaDB
Weaviate
Milvus
REST API development and integration.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering.
Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines.



Primary Skill Set

Agentic AI
AI Agents
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Python
LangChain
LangGraph
LlamaIndex
CrewAI
OpenAI
Azure OpenAI
Vector Databases
Prompt Engineering
AI-native Applications
